name: A Journey Begins
description: Professor Linden has asked you to help complete the Pokédex.
steps: Meet Professor Linden in the lab.
Head north along Route 1.

name: Shards of Light
description: Team Eclipse is stealing light shards from Tessera's shrines. Find out why.
steps: Investigate the shrine in Whisperwood.
Earn the Sprout Badge in Brindle City.
Pass through Cobblecrest Cave to Port Tidewater.
Stop Team Eclipse at the Port Tidewater docks.
Earn the Tide Badge from Marina.

name: The Lost Poké Doll
description: A girl in Fernwick Town lost her Poké Doll in Whisperwood.
steps: Find the Poké Doll in Whisperwood.
Return it to the girl in Fernwick Town.

name: Mushroom Survey
description: A researcher in Brindle City wants data on mushroom Pokémon from Whisperwood.
steps: Catch a Shroomish, a Paras and a Morelull.
Report back to the researcher in Brindle City.

name: Pen Pal Pokémon
description: A sailor's kid in Port Tidewater wants to swap Pokémon stories.
steps: Show the kid a Wooper from Route 4.
Receive the kid's Pokémon in exchange.

name: Lost in Cobblecrest
description: A hiker's partner is lost somewhere in Cobblecrest Cave.
steps: Find the lost hiker in the cave's lower floor.
Tell the hiker on Route 4 the good news.

name: Shadows over Tessera
description: Team Eclipse is stealing light across Tessera. Follow the trail from Lumen Village to Seraphine Town.
steps: Head south to Lumen Village.
Find out why Voltara City is blacked out.
Earn the Spark Badge from Volta.
Visit Dr. Mira's lab in Voltara City.
Earn the Stone Badge from Garnet in Quarrytown.
Meet Warden Talo at the Ruins of Sol.
Cross Mt. Prism and stop Team Eclipse.
Earn the Mist Badge from Elowen in Seraphine Town.

name: The Traveler's Gift
description: Elder Ione of Lumen Village keeps Pokémon left by a traveler from Kanto.
steps: See the mural deep in the Lumen Ruins.
Tell Elder Ione about the mural.
Return to Elder Ione with a Key Stone.

name: Psychic Survey
description: A researcher in Lumen Village wants proof that Psychic Pokémon gather in the ruins.
steps: Catch Unown, Natu, Baltoy and Sigilyph, then report back.

name: Live Wire
description: A Voltara lineman dropped his toolbox somewhere on Route 7.
steps: Find the lineman's toolbox on Route 7.
Return the toolbox to the lineman in Voltara City.

name: Dig Site Duty
description: Quarrytown's foreman lost his lucky pickaxe on Route 8.
steps: Find the foreman's pickaxe on Route 8.
Return the pickaxe to the foreman.
Bring a fossil to the Quarrytown Fossil Lab.

name: Sun and Moon
description: An acolyte at the Ruins of Sol wants to see the sun and the moon side by side.
steps: Catch Solrock and Lunatone, then visit the acolyte.

name: Song of the Mist
description: A bard in Seraphine Town is writing a ballad about cotton-winged birds.
steps: Show the bard a Swablu.

name: Embers and Frost
description: Team Eclipse is hunting for light west of Seraphine. Earn the Ember and Frost Badges.
steps: Travel west along Route 9 and defeat Blaise at the Ashfall Gym.
Find Quartz in Crystal Cavern, south of Ashfall.
Cross the bay on Route 11 and meet Hollis in Frostmere Town.
Defeat Isolde at the Frostmere Gym.
Climb Route 12 to Dragonspire City.

name: Lapras's Song
description: A homesick Lapras at the Sea Cottage on Route 11 loves pearls.
steps: Find a Big Pearl on the islet in the middle of Route 11.
Bring the Big Pearl to the Sea Cottage.

name: Lost on the Ice
description: Pip from Frostmere went to watch the Snom on Route 12's frozen slope.
steps: Find Pip on the frozen slope of Route 12.
Tell Pip's grandmother in Frostmere that he's safe.

name: Hot Spring Mail
description: A gentleman at the Ashfall hot spring inn wants a letter delivered to his daughter.
steps: Deliver the letter to the scientist at Hollis's Lodge in Frostmere.

name: Crystal Companion
description: Quartz's aide wants to see a Carbink, the jewel Pokémon of Crystal Cavern.
steps: Catch a Carbink and show it to Quartz's aide.
